caption: The drawing consists of two principal objects on a plain, beige background. In the upper left corner, there is a lightly sketched outline of a jug or vessel with a single handle on the right, a narrow neck, and a rounded body, with some decorative lines on the left upper body of the vessel. The central focus of the composition is a blue-toned bird perched on a stylized branch with leaves, situated on top of an irregularly shaped grayish slab or rock. The bird, depicted in profile facing to the right, has detailed plumage on its wings and tail, with subtle variations of blue tones used for shading and contouring. The branch under the bird is brown with blue-tinted leaves. There is a signature at the bottom right of the page, overlapping slightly with the slab.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
